preservedLimits: Owner discover is a live bounded saved-memory search, not a complete snapshot or automatic task context
Public recall uses rules and does not call configured external planner or evidence judge; independent verification remains false
Exact historical evidence covers registered immutable observations; other domain source pointers remain explicit gaps
Current business state requires explicit authoritative current refs; saved interpretations and scenario estimates are not independent business verification
Dispatch guard covers canonical memory choices registered by recall coordinator before logical Pi requests; it cannot retract admitted in-flight requests or certify raw RAG/file history
Independent exact memory evidence tools authorize at read time; previously unregistered IDs are not automatically added to dispatch registry and remain a follow-up coverage item
Unsupported runtime adapters cannot receive canonical memory bodies through that recall coordinator inside the guarded run
Internal budget verifies serialized UTF-8 bytes; the compatible maxTokens field does not prove arbitrary provider token counts or full prompt/tool budgets
Access schema has positive grants; default denial and revocation win, no explicit negative grant row was invented
Quality is a userwide bounded sample, not per-Work execution health; GET is readonly and maintenance POST is explicit
Actual model answer quality, authenticated-session login, daily instance, SQLite/native and mobile specialty checks are not validated
Specialized policy/correction/document/continuity hosts remain T5/T6; old Brain service/repository are not wholly removed
No real model, private messages, external actions, money or business Work execution used
correctedBeforeFinalFreeze: Final union rechecks source versions, permissions and applicability after attempts and retry
Selected evidence body is admitted before configured external evidence judge
Retry audit failure never returns an earlier successful body
Budget preserves complete selected constraints and final Unicode source ranges
Owner recall reserves late warning space and reports pending updates
Grant create/revoke and final context share the owner authority lock and same-transaction access audit
Chat async producer lifetime and real selected runtime binding cover initial and later tool recalls
Canonical compatibility discovery bypasses old cache and captures expiry clock after every row lock
Discovery removes task ContextTrace; no implicit ownerwide fallback on default Chat recall failure
Search and host telemetry/errors omit original query bodies, result previews, SQL and connection details
Compatibility request transport/UTF8/auth/authority fields bounded and rejected consistently
Source freeze includes actual memory/records source files
